title: novarc-harness-doctor state (v2)
description: Single source of truth for one review run over one or more harnesses. A harness is one user account's config (kind user) or one project repo (kind project). The board is rendered from this file. `scores` are computed by render-board.mjs and never written by hand. All collections are flat arrays keyed by `harness` so partial findings from several sessions merge without conflicts.

language.description: Language of the board chrome; item texts are written by the agent in the user's language.

title.description: Short name shown as the board title, e.g. the user's first name or the project name. Never an e-mail.

followUpOf.description: Set when this run was started as the follow-up of an earlier one (run.mjs init --follow-up). The per-harness comparison is in harnesses[].followUp.

channel.description: How decisions travel from the board back to the session. artifact: claude.ai Artifact database; server: local serve-board.mjs; file: opened from disk, decisions pasted in chat.

accounts.description: Agent accounts found on this machine and how their user harnesses relate. One account can be the primary; the others are linked (same provider) or replicated (other providers) from it.

primary.description: Account id the user chose as primary, or null while undecided.

syncInstalled.description: true once the self-healing sync check is registered.

identity.description: Masked account identity (first 2 characters of the local part, then the domain). Never a full e-mail.

path.description: Display path of the config dir, home as ~.

isDefault.description: true for the provider's default config dir.

host.description: Host app that owns this config dir, when it is not the provider's default (e.g. a multi-account launcher).

harness.description: Id of this account's user harness in `harnesses`.

elements.description: How many harness elements exist in this config dir.

suggested.description: What the account comparison suggests for this account once a primary is chosen.

suggestionText.description: One line for the board, in the run language.

mode.description: linked: same provider, elements are links into the primary. replicated: other provider, the portable subset is generated from the primary. independent: not managed.

key.description: Stable key of this harness across runs: the name of its folder under history/. See references/follow-up.md.

name.description: Tab label: project folder name, or the account label for a user harness.

path.description: Display path: home as ~. Never an absolute personal path.

account.description: Account id, for a user harness.

inherits.description: Harness id this one takes its elements from (a linked secondary account). Its tab shows the inherited elements as such and lists only what differs.

impactSkipped.description: Why this harness has no impact measurement. shared-sessions: the account uses the same sessions folder as the harness named in `with`, where they are measured. no-transcript-reader: the skill cannot read this provider's sessions.

history.description: Earlier reviews of this harness, oldest first, from its review records. Written by run.mjs build.

score.description: The score that review ended with.

rounds.description: One entry per harness and round. Only status 'done' counts toward the score.

layers.description: What enters a session, in load order, per harness.

file.description: Id in `files`, when the layer is one file.

tokens.description: Approximate tokens this layer adds to every session.

files.description: Snapshot of the harness files the board's explorer shows. Written by snapshot-harness.mjs, never by hand: content is masked for secrets and capped. A change is drawn inside the file it touches by locating its `before` (pending) or `after` (applied) text in `content`.

path.description: Display path: ~ for home, ./ for the project root.

content.description: File text with secrets masked. Empty when `omitted` is set.

omitted.description: Why the content is not included. linked: this file is a link and its text lives in the file named by `linkTo`. not-included: left out of this rendering of the board.

loaded.description: always: enters every session. on-demand: read when the agent needs it. never: not read by the agent (a git hook, a CI workflow).

linkTo.description: Display path this file is a link to, when it is one.

role.description: One line on what this file does in the harness, in the user's language. Written by the reviewing agent.

inheritedFrom.description: Harness id that really owns this file, when it reaches this harness through a link.

inventory.description: Everything found, including what is fine. Every entry carries an opinion.

item.description: The item raised from this entry, if any.

id.description: Harness prefix, dash, number: U-1, ACME-12.

origin.description: Where the finding lives; absent means active. See references/scoring.md.

file.description: Display path of the file the finding is about, when it has no `changes`.

check.description: Id of the harness-checks.mjs check this item was confirmed from, if any.

group.description: Id in `groups`, when the same decision covers several harnesses.

rev.description: Revision of what this item proposes: a hash of its harness, class, proposal and changes, written by run.mjs build. A decision applies only to the revision it was made on.

evidence.description: Counts, file:line, commit ids. Never secret values or transcript text.

decision.description: What the user decided, in their words or a short paraphrase.

question.description: A question the user asked about this item from the board, waiting for an answer in chat.

verified.description: What was checked after the change.

saves.description: What fixing this item is expected to save over the run window.

metric.description: The measurement this saving should show up in, so a later run can check it. Omit only when none fits: the saving then counts toward tokens-per-session.

how.description: One line on where the number comes from.

previous.description: Set by the reviewer when this is the same finding as an item of an earlier review of this harness.

history.description: What happened to this finding before, from the review records. Written by run.mjs build from `previous`.

times.description: Reviews in which this finding appeared before this one.

lastNote.description: The note the user left with that decision.

lesson.description: The teaching part of the diagnosis, in the user's language. See references/teaching.md.

changes.description: One entry per contiguous edit. The board draws it inside the file: removed text in red, added text in green, with `why` beside it.

file.description: Id in `files`. Omit for a file that does not exist yet.

path.description: Display path, the same as the file's.

before.description: Exact contiguous text as it is on disk (and in the file snapshot); empty string for a new file or a pure insertion. No elisions.

after.description: Exact text that replaces it; empty string for a removal.

insertAfter.description: For a pure insertion (`before` empty) into an existing file: the exact line after which `after` is inserted. Omit to append at the end.

why.description: One or two sentences shown beside this edit: what this exact edit does and why, in the user's language.

applied.description: true once this exact change is on disk and verified.

groups.description: The same finding in several harnesses, decided once. Approving a group approves its items; the user can exclude some.

rev.description: Hash of the member items and their revisions, written by run.mjs build.

defenses.description: What already protects a harness, checked in this run. Listed on the board; never adds points.

decisions.description: Decisions already taken into the state, newest last. Written by run.mjs from the board channel or from chat.

itemStatus.description: open: needs the user's decision. approved: user said yes, waiting for an executor. in-progress: being applied. fixed: applied and verified. failed: applied, verification failed, restored. declined: user keeps it as is. deferred: user will decide later. ok: looked at, nothing to change. not-applicable.

runId.description: Run the decision was made in, as the board and `run.mjs decide` record it.

target.description: An item id, a group id, or `accounts.primary` (with the chosen account id in `note`).

exclude.description: Item ids left out of a group approval.

rev.description: The `rev` of the item or group as the user saw it. A decision whose rev no longer matches is not applied.

baseline.description: Every item treated as open: the harness before this run.

projected.description: Approved and in-progress items treated as fixed: where the harness lands once what the user approved is applied.

metric.description: A measurement that can be compared between two reviews. Per-session values, so two windows with different activity compare.

followUp.description: This harness now, against its last review record: did the expected effect happen, and is what was applied still there. Written by run.mjs build. See references/follow-up.md.

days.description: Days between that review and this measurement.

enough.description: false while too few days or sessions have passed to compare.

readyAt.description: When enough days will have passed.

then.description: The score that review ended with.

expected.description: Its projected score: where it said the harness would land.

now.description: The baseline of this run: the harness as found today.

expected.description: Where the fixed items said it would land; null when no fixed item named this metric.

verdict.description: confirmed and partial are read against an expectation; improved, no-change and worse are the plain change.

items.description: Ids, in that review, of the fixed items that named this metric.
What that review left: each fixed item checked on disk, each declined or deferred item carried.

check.description: For a fixed item: is its change still on disk. changed: the file holds neither the text before nor the text after the change.

saves.description: Tokens it expected to save over that review's window.

now.description: Id of the item in this run that is the same finding, when it came back.

expectedTokensPerSession.description: Tokens per session the fixed items expected to save.

observedTokensPerSession.description: Change in tokens per session actually measured (negative is a saving).

cameBack.description: Fixed items found again as findings in this run.

impact.description: What this harness cost over the window. Filled from session-impact.mjs by run.mjs; `estimates` are added by the agent with their source.

weightedTotal.description: Total in input-token equivalents, using the price weights in references/catalog/pricing-weights.json.

weightedByKind.description: The weighted total split by token kind, in input-token equivalents.

weights.description: Which price weights produced the weighted numbers, as session-impact.mjs reports them.

sources.description: Price pages the weights were taken from.

verifiedAt.description: When the weights were last checked against their sources.

perModelFamily.description: Per model family: turns, tokens and the ratios applied.

weightedTotal.description: The same total in input-token equivalents.

turns.description: Model turns in the window, over the sessions counted.

carriedTokens.description: The starting context of each session times its turns: it is re-read on every later turn.

items.description: Item ids that address this kind of waste.

estimates.description: Savings that are not measured. Shown apart from measured waste and never added into the measured total.

id.description: Stable id of the estimate, from references/catalog/estimates.json.

source.description: Where the number comes from, in one line.

skillsNeverInvoked.description: Configured skills measured as never invoked in the window.

mcpServersNeverCalled.description: Configured MCP servers measured as never called in the window.

skillsUnknown.description: Configured skills whose use could not be measured. Never treat as unused.

mcpServersUnknown.description: Configured MCP servers whose use could not be measured. Never treat as unused.

example.description: true only in the template example: numbers are illustrative.

elements.description: Structured inventory the explorer renders as views. Written by snapshot-harness.mjs; the reviewing agent may add `verdict`, `note` and `item` fields.

hooks.description: Everything that runs automatically: agent hooks, git hooks, CI jobs, scheduled routines.

event.description: PreToolUse, SessionStart, pre-commit, push, a cron expression...

command.description: Command line, masked and trimmed to 300 characters.

file.description: File id where the hook is registered.

script.description: File id of the script it runs, when it is one of the snapshot files.

blocking.description: Whether it can stop the action. null when it could not be told.

invocations.description: Times invoked in the window; null when not measured.

reason.description: Why this verdict; must stand on its own.

calls.description: Tool calls in the window; null when not measured.

cli.description: Official CLI that can replace it, when the catalog knows one.
